accounts.name: signer
docs: The player's wallet or its session key, even if expired (spec v2 §4).

accounts.name: old_record
docs: Record of the current name; required iff the player has one. Its rent goes back to the owner.

accounts.name: username_record
docs: Record of the current name; required iff the player has one.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: Fresh keypair; Switchboard creates the account at this address.

accounts.name: session_key
docs: Browser key; it receives `fee_budget` to pay its own transaction fees.

accounts.name: program
docs: Only the program's upgrade authority may initialize, so nobody can front-run the admin role.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The player's wallet or its session key (spec v2 §4).

accounts.name: username_record
docs: `init` makes a taken name fail.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Receives the record's rent.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The owner or the session key itself, even if expired.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The only possible destination of the lamports.

accounts.name: player
docs: Payouts can only go to the `Player` account that owns the bet.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone may start the round; they pay as the reveal's `payer`.

types.name: ActiveBet
docs: A player's bet in play; replaces the v1.1 `Bet` account (spec v2 §3.1).

fields.name: auto_cash_out
docs: Auto cash-out target in ten-thousandths; 0 means none.

types.name: BankDeposited
docs: Authoritative events: off-chain projections must be rebuildable from these and the `Round` accounts.

fields.name: player
docs: Wallet that owns the `Player` account.

types.name: BetSettled
docs: Self-contained record of a bet, so it stays auditable without per-bet accounts (spec v2 §10).

fields.name: randomness_account
docs: Switchboard randomness account controlled by the `randomness_authority` PDA; default = unset.

types.name: HouseVault
docs: Holds the bank and the stakes in play as lamports; `reserved_exposure` covers every active bet.
Player balances never live here: they stay in each `Player` PDA.

types.name: Player
docs: Per-wallet account. Its lamports hold `balance` on top of its rent (spec v2 §3.1).

fields.name: balance
docs: Free lamports the player can bet or sell; the stake in play is in the vault.

fields.name: total_wagered
docs: Stakes settled in `Crashed` rounds, in lamports: the source of experience.

fields.name: max_session_slots
docs: Longest session a player may open, counted from the creation slot.

fields.name: username_cooldown_slots
docs: Minimum slots between two username changes (0 = no cooldown).

fields.name: randomness_account
docs: Switchboard account and commit slot fixed by `close_betting`; `start_round` must match them.

types.name: Session
docs: Browser key allowed to bet and cash out for the player (spec v2 §4).

types.name: Username
docs: Validated username: 3–16 bytes in `[a-z0-9_]`; `len = 0` means no name (spec v2 §3.3).

types.name: UsernameRecord
docs: Makes a username unique: the account exists iff the name is taken.

constants.name: RANDOMNESS_AUTHORITY_SEED
docs: PDA that owns the house's Switchboard randomness account (ADR 0002, final decision 2).
